name: Golden Chickpea-Coconut Curry with Bell Pepper, Jalapeño, Basil & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup basmati rice
8 fl oz (1 cup) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 red bell pepper
1 green bell pepper
1 jalapeño pepper
½ small pkg fresh basil

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, trim, seed, and medium dice bell peppers. Place in a medium bowl.

Thinly slice jalapeño pepper into rings; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Peel and mince garlic. Add both to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
1 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, drain and rinse chickpeas. Pat dry with paper towels, then add to the bowl.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add veggies, chickpeas, and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are golden and tender, 6-8 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp virgin coconut oil
2 tsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves.

When the veggies are done, add basil and coconut milk to the skillet, then stir to combine. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the curry is slightly thickened, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message: ½ (13.5 fl oz) can coconut milk

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide rice and curry between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
